text:
```yaml
name: E2E Docs
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  e2e-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build
      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Upload coverage reports
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          file: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: e2e
          name: e2e-docs
```
